card.name: Words right before a verb like try
card.fires_on: Small words such as don't, never, who, or not be, placed just before a verb. The next word is often try, attempt, or expect. It also fires on a name before a surname.

modes.label: Negation before a verb
modes.description: Don't, never, or not directly before an expected verb in advice or warnings.
modes.example: If you want to lose weight, don<<'t>> strength-train.

modes.label: Relative who before a clause
modes.description: The word who opening a clause about a person who tries or intends something.
modes.example: if any brother has a wife<< who>> is an unbeliever, and she cons

modes.label: First name before surname
modes.description: A first name in a discovery line, just before the surname.

card.writes: It makes try and attempt more likely as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on little words like don't or never where a verb such as try could come next.
evidence: If you want to lose weight, don<<'t>> strength-train.
